# Althaf M. — Game Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Althaf Tristan Maheswara, a Unity game developer.

## Pages

- [Home](./index.html): About, game projects, programming languages, and socials.
- [Game detail](./game.html?id=bounce): Each game has its own page with screenshots, dev time, budget, tools, and lessons learned.

## Data

- [games.js](./data/games.js): All site content is modular and rendered from this file.
